names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 aprilie, «Sfântul Mucenic Leonid».

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 22. април ст. ст., „Св. муч. Леонид.“, with „Св.“ and the rank муч. left off. The heading gives him no city, no year and not even the fatherhood this corpus keeps in his display name — „Отац Оригенов“ is the body's first sentence — so the bare forename is all of it, and `leonid-presbyter-martyr-1937` and `leonides-of-epidaurus` already share it: a deliberate fold, recorded in the batch's commit message.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfântul Leonid a fost decapitat în anul 202».
